title: 1982 AHSME Problem 22
statement: In a narrow alley of width \(w\) a ladder of length \(a\) is placed with its foot at a point \(P\) between the walls. Resting against one wall at \(Q,\) a distance \(k\) above the ground, the ladder makes a \(45^\circ\) angle with the ground. Resting against the other wall at \(R,\) a distance \(h\) above the ground, the ladder makes a \(75^\circ\) angle with the ground. The width \(w\) is equal to

solutions.text:
The horizontal distances from \(P\) to the walls are \(a\cos75^\circ\) and \(a\cos45^\circ,\) so \(w=a(\cos75^\circ+\cos45^\circ).\) The sum-to-product identity gives \(\cos75^\circ+\cos45^\circ=\sin75^\circ.\) Since \(h=a\sin75^\circ,\) \(w=h.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is E.
hints: Express the two horizontal portions of the alley using cosines
